sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Your letter gives 51 days' notice (doc:20260911-70110-P01), while our framework agreement requires 90 days (ctr:4600070110#3.1).
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 132.64 per unit (cost:310010).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).

Please find our proposal below.
If faster payment helps you, we are open to it, as shown in the packages.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

In recognition of these facts and your offer of 14-day payment terms, we agree to shift the effective date to 1 January 2027. Consequently, we are pleased to revise our offer to €134.70 per unit under these updated terms.

Our updated offer stands at a price of €134.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

decisions.tactician: Fast payment gives the supplier the cash it wants at little cost to us. The January date respects the contract and lowers our C compared with a November start. The health rung on o2 ties for the lowest C of any option, €1,116,649, which is €15,660 better than E0. E0 offers today's price, which sits below the supplier's estimated cost, so it risks the relationship charge and an angry rejection. The notice-period argument supports the January date, the should-cost argument anchors near full cost, and the volume-growth argument offers the supplier recognition and future business.

decisions.tactician: o2 holds the January date and the short payment it values, so we concede nothing new on terms. Moving the date to November or April, or lengthening payment, raises our C at matching value to it. step_25 gives C €1,117,549. That is near E0's €1,117,009 but a more credible concession pace after its €3.08 move, and it is still below health and margin danger on its full-cost range. Order history and the delivery scorecard are new argument kinds that support restraint. a1 is weak because the power index has recently risen. Accepting €134.70 now would leave about €3k on the table, and the supplier is open rather than at final offer.

why.tactician: The sheet is agreed, and accepting it locks in C €1,117,549, down from €1,153,780 at the open. The o2 health range is €124.60-€132.23, so the remaining gain from going lower is small, and with the supplier likely near or below full cost the relationship charge would eat into it. Its status is agreed, so the price it will settle at has stopped moving. Our only unused argument (a1, falling power prices) is weak because its own data shows power prices rising recently. Other options cost us more: o3 has about the same C at a higher price, and o4/o8/o9 come out higher in C. A further counter risks souring an owner who expects recognition, for little upside. E0's default push is therefore not worth it.
